distribution_definitions.REQUIRED_RESEARCH_CORE: Behavior required in the research-first phase; spec deferral is 无.
distribution_definitions.ADAPTED_SCOPED_CHECK: Original TOP22 bar narrowed to a bounded local research check; broader scope deferred.
distribution_definitions.DEFERRED_INSTITUTIONAL_REQUIREMENT: Original requirement's institutional/off-host scope deferred; no research PASS is implied.

notes: Mapping is a reviewable design projection of the spec table; it does not modify legacy scores.
Deferred items do not block experimentation but are never auto-converted to PASS.
Source top-tier statuses are inventory only and cannot promote a research verdict.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 决策时可知性、迟到修订、样本对齐回归
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. Must independently re-verify decision-time knowability, late revisions and sample alignment.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 当前实验输入来源、可用时间、质量可核查
requirements.deferred_scope: 商业 tick/盘口合同与 SLA；依赖盘口的策略仍需相应数据
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Scoped to provenance/quality of the current experiment input; commercial tick/order-book contracts and SLA are deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 全部试验含失败、预算、候选与数据版本留存
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. Every trial including failures, budgets, candidates and data versions must persist.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 先在明确限定的市场完成闭环
requirements.deferred_scope: 全资产覆盖
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Close the loop on a clearly bounded market first; full asset coverage is deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 训练内选择、锁定 OOS、多重尝试控制
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. In-training selection, locked OOS and multiple-trial control are required behavior.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 独立复算、简单基准与证伪测试
requirements.deferred_scope: 机构评审身份设施；模型无效可得出合格否定结论
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Independent recompute, simple benchmark and falsification tests are local; institutional review-identity infrastructure is deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 有限仓位、现金、杠杆、换手及集中度
requirements.deferred_scope: 全机构跨 book 配置
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Bounded position, cash, leverage, turnover and concentration checks apply; full institutional cross-book allocation is deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 成本与容量实际影响可执行持仓
requirements.deferred_scope: 超出当前市场的校准
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Costs and capacity must actually affect executable positions; calibration beyond the current market is deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 非有限值拒绝、损失上限、未知即停
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. Non-finite rejection, loss limits and unknown-means-stop are required behavior.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 同机中断重启、不重发、不重复计账
requirements.deferred_scope: 机构长期 SLO
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Same-machine interruption restart with no duplicate send or accounting is the research check; institutional long-term SLO is deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 唯一 V2 账本，订单/成交/费用/现金守恒
requirements.deferred_scope: 旧 V1 继续隔离
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. One canonical V2 ledger with order/fill/fee/cash conservation; legacy V1 stays isolated and deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 单场所仿真/测试网口径一致
requirements.deferred_scope: 多场所智能路由和生产 TCA
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. Single-venue simulation/testnet semantics must agree; multi-venue smart routing and production TCA are deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: AI 无自批和真实交易权限
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. AI must have no self-approval or real-trading authority.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 提示/模型/工具/调用身份、越权回归
requirements.deferred_scope: 外部服务商与机构级评审设施
requirements.reason: Deferred scope is off-host/external institutional infrastructure; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS. Deferred scope is external service providers and institutional review facilities; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 实验与测试网授权可追踪
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. Experiment and testnet authorization must be traceable.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 本机操作员与研究进程权限隔离
requirements.deferred_scope: 外部 OIDC、mTLS、机构多方身份部署
requirements.reason: Deferred scope is off-host/external institutional infrastructure; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS. Deferred scope is external OIDC, mTLS and institutional multi-party identity deployment; it does not block local research but is not a PASS.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 每批专项测试；里程碑完整验收
requirements.deferred_scope: 不要求每个实验重建全部发布制品
requirements.reason: Deferred scope is off-host/external institutional infrastructure; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS. Full release-artifact rebuild per experiment is deferred institutional release scope; it is not a research PASS.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 固定依赖、适用漏洞检查、源码身份
requirements.deferred_scope: 异机可复现构建、外部 WORM 与独立签发基础设施
requirements.reason: Deferred scope is off-host/external institutional infrastructure; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS. Deferred scope is cross-host reproducible builds, external WORM and independent signing infrastructure; not a research PASS.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 保留原始输入和实验记录，输出可重跑
requirements.deferred_scope: 外置加密备份不阻塞单机研究
requirements.reason: Deferred scope is off-host/external institutional infrastructure; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS. External encrypted backup destinations are deferred and do not block single-machine research; not a PASS.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 同机任务恢复和断点验证
requirements.deferred_scope: 异机恢复、30/90 天历史与整机灾备
requirements.reason: Deferred scope is off-host/external institutional infrastructure; it does not block single-machine research but is not a PASS. Cross-host recovery, 30/90-day history and full disaster recovery are deferred; not a research PASS.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 一个可靠研究入口，合同测试
requirements.deferred_scope: 非关键页面与视觉完善
requirements.reason: Research stage applies a narrowed local check; the broader scope is deferred and is not required for experimentation. One reliable research entry point with contract tests; non-critical pages and visual polish are deferred.

requirements.research_stage_requirement: 来源、失败、成本、状态和未知值真实展示
requirements.deferred_scope: 无
requirements.reason: Spec lists no deferred scope; the research-first phase requires this behavior itself. Sources, failures, costs, status and unknown values must be shown truthfully.
